image_description: A top-down view of a wooden table set with various food items. In the foreground, a white oval plate holds a whole green cucumber, a peeled section of cucumber revealing pale flesh, and a small green apple. To the left, a bowl contains red tomatoes and sliced red peppers. In the center, a bowl holds dark purple eggplants. To the right, there are yellow apples, an orange, and a sliced citrus fruit (orange/tangerine) with a fork.
